technology_name: Recombinant Growth Factor-Based Wound Healing Scaffold
institution: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST)
problem_solved: Delayed wound healing in chronic wounds and diabetic conditions
description: This wound healing technology incorporates recombinant growth factors such as VEGF and TGF-alpha within an alginate-based scaffold. The controlled delivery system is designed to enhance wound healing and support tissue regeneration by providing growth factors directly at the wound site.
applications:
Advanced wound care and regenerative medicine centers
Hospitals, diabetic foot care clinics, and chronic wound management facilities
Biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies developing growth factor-based therapies
Medical device manufacturers producing bioactive wound healing products
Research institutions and tissue engineering organizations focused on regenerative healthcare solutions
